decisions.reason: Moving the branded placard to a customer-facing front position does not change the machine's beige primary color or green accents.
The placard relocation does not change the established DJ-turntable-inspired visual theme.
The placard relocation is independent of the rendered stainless-steel spout design; the source message's separate spout approval is already represented in this candidate's history.
Changing the placard's position and viewing orientation does not alter the solenoid valve or button-controlled dispensing behavior.
The customer-facing placard placement does not change the controlled-pour or beverage-preservation requirements.
The placard relocation does not affect bowl depth, capacity, or the acceptability of refilling.
Moving the placard from the back to the front does not necessarily change the enclosure's size or side-profile thickness.
The placard's placement and viewing direction do not alter the requirement to minimize splashing.
The source states that the spout will face the baristas, which is consistent with and does not modify the existing barista-facing orientation.
Relocating the placard does not change the required structural support or operational stability.
The placard relocation does not affect whisk dimensions, material suitability, or the selected whisk style.
The branded placard's customer-facing position does not alter the required mixing quality or foam consistency.
